commonFacts.application: WAI public portal links OAuth; no account entered
commonFacts.sourceConflicts: How-to-apply first paragraph says no later than March30 but final paragraph, FAQ and guide agree active March30 or later; use corroborated latter. PDF says EST whereas live cycle page says ET; preserve live ET. Blanket membership nondiscrimination is qualified by FAQ award-specific requirements.
commonFacts.privacy: Only public program facts extracted; no applicant materials entered or collected.

awards.name: AeroStar ATP CTP Certification Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: ATP CTP course, 7–9 days, for the ATP multi-engine knowledge-test prerequisite. Training must begin within one year. Lodging and transportation excluded; nontransferable and no cash conversion.

awards.name: Airlines on Autopilot MEI Scholarship
awards.conditions: U.S. applicants holding CFI and commercial pilot certificates with multi-engine ratings; passion for teaching and intent to instruct through airline minimum hours. Paid to flight school; complete within one year.

awards.name: Anne Bridge Baddour Aviation Scholarship
awards.conditions: Guide describes a female pilot advancing toward instrument, multi-engine or ATP training.

awards.name: Dare to Dream Scholarship
awards.conditions: Private pilot certificate; working toward instrument, multi-engine, commercial or CFI. FAA class 1–3 medical or BasicMed required. One recommendation must be from a pilot who has flown with applicant. Merit, goals, dedication and community contributions considered; paid to school, complete within one year.

awards.name: Diane Ballweg Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman over age 30 pursuing initial or advanced flight training; outside the graduating-high-school audience.

awards.name: ISA+21 Financial Scholarship 2027
awards.conditions: Women pursuing CFI, CFII or MEI; paid to an accredited aviation college/university, technical school or government-approved flight school. Complete within one year.

awards.name: Keep Flying International Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2027 guide expressly says international applicants only; private certificate, 100 flight hours and all required written exams. Outside the intended U.S. Whitefish audience; do not reuse broader 2025 worldwide wording.

awards.name: Kylie Murray Memorial Women in Aviation International Scholarship
awards.conditions: Commercial multi-engine land or MEI training at ATP Flight School, 5-day/10-hour or 7-day/15-hour program. Flight training fees only; travel, lodging and examiner fees excluded. Provider says recipient must meet program requirements, without restating the older 2025 certification/athletics conditions; do not carry those forward.

awards.name: Juliana Turchetti Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Women pursuing a seaplane rating. Paid to flight school or recognized insured training provider; use within 12 months.

awards.name: The Stephanie Goetz and Endre Holen Multi-Engine Commercial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Private pilot certificate and instrument rating; FAA class 1–3 medical. Multi-engine commercial rating toward a professional pilot career; need and community service considered. One-page essay of no more than 500 words covering experience, goals, passion and giving back; recommendations are described as a plus but common WAI requirements still apply.

awards.name: WASP Elaine D. Harmon Tailwheel Scholarship
awards.conditions: Tailwheel endorsement for further warbird, vintage-aircraft or backcountry flying. International applicants welcome but training must be in the U.S.; applicant must check provider certification prerequisites. Paid to provider and used within one year.

awards.name: The White Family Legacy Scholarship
awards.conditions: Private pilot certificate, 100 flight hours and current written-test results for sought instrument/multi-engine rating or commercial/CFI certificate. One recommendation from a pilot who has flown with applicant. Merit, goals, dedication and community service considered; essay covers plans and volunteer dates/hours; paid to school and completed within one year.

awards.name: American Airlines Engineering Scholarship
awards.conditions: Enrolled in an accredited U.S. college/university engineering program; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; GPA at least 3.0. Aviation career interest, academics, accomplishments, teamwork, leadership and community service considered.

awards.name: The NKL Aerospace Engineering Scholarship
awards.conditions: Enrolled or accepted in an accredited two- or four-year college, technical institution or certificate program with declared aerospace engineering major; GPA at least 3.0; U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen; STEM/aviation/WAI volunteer. Acceptance letter and 500–1,000 word essay on financial need, inspiration, career and service; paid to institution.

awards.name: PSA Airlines Engineering Scholarship
awards.conditions: Pursuing aerospace engineering or a related aviation engineering career, with interest in leadership, innovation, safety and the future of flight.

awards.name: Amazon Maintenance Technician Scholarship
awards.conditions: Guide supports a woman enrolled in an A&P program or an aspiring maintenance technician. Academic excellence, leadership and aviation-community impact considered; 500-word essay and two recommendations.

awards.name: American Airlines Aircraft Maintenance Technician Scholarship
awards.conditions: Currently enrolled in an A&P program or aviation-maintenance-technology degree at an accredited U.S. maintenance program; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; GPA at least 3.0. Academics, accomplishments, teamwork, leadership and community service considered.

awards.name: Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Guide describes a female student currently enrolled in an accredited maintenance program or college/university, who should have GPA 3.0 or better; no mandatory minimum established. Aviation passion, career commitment and ability to complete training considered; two character references. Paid to school; complete within one year.

awards.name: Epic Flight Academy Aviation Maintenance Technician Scholarship (WAI)
awards.conditions: Entry-level applicants seeking FAA A&P certification through Epic’s Part 147 program. Choose New Smyrna Beach, Florida, or Erlanger, Kentucky/CVG. Two campus options are not separate funds. This is the WAI-administered award, distinct from Epic’s direct high-school and other association awards.

awards.name: Evelyn Lockwood Greene Memorial A&P Maintenance Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman pursuing aviation maintenance/fabrication with passion for vintage-aircraft restoration, maintenance and flying; funds A&P certification.

awards.name: Evelyn Lockwood Greene Memorial Inspector Authority Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman pursuing aviation maintenance/fabrication and vintage-aircraft work; funds an Inspector Authority certification preparation course. Experienced certification pathway, not entry-level A&P funding.

awards.name: GlennCo Advanced Avionics Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Three-day advanced electrical/avionic troubleshooting course targeted to line and base maintenance technicians; no supported entry-level student route established.

awards.name: GlennCo Electrical Repair Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Three-day level-one aircraft electrical repair/troubleshooting class for entry-level technicians, including standard wiring practices and hands-on tools/materials.

awards.name: PSA Airlines Maintenance Scholarship
awards.conditions: Working toward an A&P mechanic career in commercial aviation; driven, reliable, caring and passionate about aviation.

awards.name: Vertical Aviation / WAI Maintenance Technician Certificate Scholarship
awards.conditions: Already enrolled in an FAA-approved Part 147 maintenance-technician certificate program or international equivalent; applicants expecting certification before January 1, 2027 are ineligible.

awards.name: The Astronaut Al Worden Endeavour Scholarship
awards.conditions: Ten-day summer 2027 Space Camp experience for STEAM students and teachers; not postsecondary tuition or vocational certification. Program-type policy hold; 3-minute video and finalist interview described.

awards.name: Capt. Sandy Anderson Memorial Scholarship for Professional Development
awards.conditions: Currently working in aviation/aerospace and seeking a certificate/degree to advance into management; must prove program qualifications and career advancement. Outside direct high-school-to-postsecondary intake.

awards.name: Carol M. SaNogueira WAI Connecticut Chapter Aviation Scholarship
awards.conditions: Text requires residence, work or school in Connecticut for engineering, A&P or pilot training, then says Connecticut preference and all applicants considered. Material geographic contradiction unresolved; do not convert to nationwide eligibility.

awards.name: Elisha Hall Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman advancing in flight training at any phase, scheduling/dispatch, aviation management, maintenance or avionics. Cincinnati/Tri-State candidates preferred, all considered on character, need, community involvement and accomplishments. Limited conference assistance is award-specific, not a general entitlement.

awards.name: Janet Clark Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Aviation career advancement across ATC, management, avionics, dispatch, engineering, flight attendant, mechanics, meteorology, navigation or pilot. Pilot applicants must already hold a private pilot certificate. Washington chapter sponsorship alone does not establish a residency restriction.

awards.name: Mary Ann Eiff Memorial Outreach Award
awards.conditions: Recognizes aviation outreach: individual receives lifetime WAI membership, or chapter receives outreach contribution. Not individual education funding; type-policy hold. Current member/chapter in good standing, essay and two recommendations.

awards.name: MzeroA Gold Lifetime Membership Scholarship
awards.conditions: Lifetime online ground-school membership for sport, private, instrument, commercial, CFI, fundamentals of instruction and remote-pilot preparation. In-kind training benefit; inclusion-type policy unresolved, no cash scholarship inferred.

awards.name: Yukiko Howell Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Pursuing higher education or continuing STEM classes at an accredited institution, including two-/four-year, technical or certificate programs; STEM/aviation/WAI volunteering in prior year. Career examples include engineering, ATC, avionics, dispatch, mechanics, meteorology and STEM education.

awards.name: Jerry Holland Legacy Scholarship
awards.conditions: Women pursuing business aviation management/leadership, including FBO operations, marketing, airport administration, customer experience and aviation business development. Leadership, integrity, service and aviation commitment considered.

awards.name: Republic Airways Aviation Management Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female applicant pursuing a degree in aviation management, dispatch or similar fields.

awards.name: Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, and Horizon Air Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time college junior or senior, female pilot pursuing airline career with Alaska Air Group, enrolled in or interested in Pilot Development Program. Outside immediate high-school-to-postsecondary entry; service, teamwork, leadership and airmanship considered.

awards.name: Amazon Professional Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman enrolled in flight training; academic excellence, leadership and aviation-community impact considered, with essay and two recommendations.

awards.name: American Airlines Flight Educational Scholarship
awards.conditions: Flight training for private, instrument, multi-engine, commercial, instructor or ATP; excludes sport/recreational certificates. Explain career benefit, why applying and WAI involvement. Older 2025 age/diploma/ground-school restrictions are not restated in the current guide and are not carried forward.

awards.name: FedEx Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female pilot pursuing instrument, multi-engine, commercial or CFI training. Paid to flight school; completed within one year.

awards.name: Frontier Airlines Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female full-time college junior, senior or graduate student in accredited aviation/aeronautical science; GPA 3.0 and instrument rating required, commercial/multi-engine preferred. Outside entry-level high-school-to-postsecondary audience.

awards.name: ISA+21 Airline Type Rating Scholarship 2027
awards.conditions: B737 or A320 type rating with Flight Training International, eight days in Miami or Denver, within 18 months. Finalists interviewed at WAI2027 conference. Entry-level eligibility not established for this advanced airline qualification.

awards.name: LIFT Academy Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female pilot pursuing professional career; current or incoming LIFT Academy student. Academic standing, accomplishments, teamwork, leadership and airmanship considered.

awards.name: PSA Airlines Flight Scholarship
awards.conditions: Commercial pilot license and working toward CFI; professional airline career goal, driven/reliable/caring qualities. This WAI fund is distinct from the NGPA PSA award.

awards.name: Republic Airways Flight Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female commercial pilot pursuing a professional career and already an RJet Cadet; academic standing, accomplishments, teamwork, leadership and airmanship considered. Additional cadet application route through careers.rjet.com; cadet status is not established by career interest.

awards.name: Sun Country and Allegiant Air “Fly in a New Direction” Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female applicant pursuing professional pilot career, private pilot certificate already held, pursuing advanced certificate/rating. Paid to school and used within one year.

awards.name: WAI / United Aviate Academy Full Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Admitted to United Aviate Academy; current students eligible before graduation. Full tuition/fees award; current amount TBD. Distinct from partial WAI scholarship and other organizations’ academy partnerships.

awards.name: WAI / United Aviate Academy Partial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Admitted to United Aviate Academy; current students eligible before graduation. Partial tuition/fees award; current amount TBD. Distinct from full WAI scholarship and other organizations’ academy partnerships.

awards.name: ISA+21 Francesca Norris Memorial Scholarship 2027
awards.conditions: Women pursuing CFI, CFII or MEI; paid to accredited aviation college/university, aviation technical school or government-approved flight school; complete within one year. The 2025 single-school restriction is not repeated for 2027.

awards.name: The Martha King Scholarship for Female Flight Instructors
awards.conditions: Female pilot pursuing initial CFI or instructor add-on; $5,000 for flight training plus lifetime King Schools online courses and flight-instructor refresher courses. Package combines cash training support and in-kind courses, not $20,000 cash.

awards.name: Bonita Jean Olson Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Enrolled or committed to attend an accredited two-/four-year college, technical institute or certificate program for STEM with aviation/aerospace career plans; STEM/aviation/WAI volunteer in prior year. Seattle/Washington preference, all considered; essay covers career and service. Current guide spells Olson; older guide spells Olsen.

awards.name: FLI Scholarship (USU Female Leadership & Impact)
awards.conditions: Listing describes a donor’s Utah State flight-program background and female leadership mission without complete applicant-specific institution or training eligibility. Do not infer eligibility from the donor biography.

awards.name: Harold Earl Paige Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Academic scholarship for community-college students. Aviation/STEM volunteering preferred; no residency restriction inferred from donor location.

awards.name: Russ Cotney and Lauren Cotney Professional Airline Pilot Career Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female U.S. citizen, college junior/senior/graduate student in accredited aviation, engineering or aeronautical science; GPA 3.0. Military/veteran or daughter preference, two recommendations and essay. Outside entry-level high-school-to-postsecondary scope.

awards.name: Amazon Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman enrolled in UAS training; academic excellence, leadership and community impact considered, with essay and two recommendations.

awards.name: Vertical Aviation / WAI Commercial Helicopter Pilot Rating Scholarship
awards.conditions: Private pilot license and enrollment in a commercial helicopter program at FAA Part 141 school or international equivalent; expected commercial rating after January 1, 2027.

awards.name: AOPA Student Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: U.S. citizen pursuing private, recreational or sport certificate; student pilot certificate by application deadline. GPA 3.0 applies if a full-time high-school, flight-program or college/university student, not universally. Additional 300-word general-aviation involvement essay. Paid to recipient and used within one year.

awards.name: Boeing Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female pursuing private, recreational, sport certificate or instrument rating. Full-time high-school, accredited flight-program or college/university students should have GPA 3.0; not a universal scalar minimum. Passion, completion commitment and two character references; paid to school, complete within one year.

awards.name: Esther Noffke Flight Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: Flight training scholarship. Current guide supplies no specific age, GPA, need or institution criteria beyond common WAI requirements; older 2025 restrictions are historical, not silently carried forward.

awards.name: Sporty’s Foundation Flight Training Scholarship for WAI Chapter Member
awards.conditions: WAI chapter member working with youth, pursuing recreational, sport or private certificate. Girls in Aviation Day volunteers receive special consideration. Flight costs only, used within one year, paid to school; includes Learn to Fly course.

awards.name: Ted Mallory Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member pursuing private pilot certificate or instrument rating.

awards.name: 2027 Wings for Val Foundation Lt. Cmdr. Lyndsay Evans Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Pilot training support for a woman demonstrating preparation, accountability, aviation commitment and leadership. No specific military-family requirement inferred from honoree.

awards.name: 2027 Wings for Val Foundation Lt. Valerie Cappelaere Delaney Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Pilot-in-training support, with determination, resilience, leadership and service emphasized. No military-family eligibility inferred from honoree; current guide does not repeat the older age 18 or medical-specific award terms.

awards.name: Women Military Aviators Dream of Flight Scholarship
awards.conditions: Woman pursuing flight ratings at an accredited institution or FAA Part 141/61 flight school in the U.S. Demonstrate persistence and ability to finish within one year; identify school and ratings, address military-aviation interest/participation and financial need. Military service is not stated as a prerequisite.

awards.name: Alaska Airlines/Horizon Air Maintenance Scholarship
awards.conditions: Female mechanic pursuing A&P with Alaska Air Group career goal; enrolled in accredited aviation maintenance or Alaska Maintenance Technician Development program, in good academic standing.

awards.name: Delta Air Lines Aircraft Maintenance Technology Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time A&P/aviation maintenance technology student, GPA at least 3.0, U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen.

awards.name: Flexjet Aircraft Maintenance Scholarship
awards.conditions: Currently enrolled in accredited U.S. A&P/aviation maintenance technology program; GPA at least 3.0; U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Academics, accomplishments, teamwork, leadership and service considered.

awards.name: Business Aviation Collective Scheduler Course
awards.conditions: Part 91 scheduler course within one year; in-kind professional course benefit with unresolved inclusion policy.

awards.name: General Chuck Yeager’s Legacy Foundation Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member demonstrating tenacity and dedication by overcoming obstacles to aviation goals. Award-specific additional essay questions were at the historical portal and are not available in the closed public catalog.

awards.name: Level Up Aviation General Scholarship
awards.conditions: Enrolled in aviation-related certification or degree program for maintenance, ATC, scheduling, engineering or other career advancement; paid to training provider. Provider mission supports economically disadvantaged/underrepresented groups but does not supply a hard individual eligibility threshold.

awards.name: Delta Air Lines Propel Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member in Delta Propel collegiate, company or community partner path; intended for women advancing toward professional airline pilot career.

awards.name: ADF/North American Flight Control Dispatch Certificate Scholarship
awards.conditions: Aircraft dispatcher FAA 121 certificate tuition, books, training and examiner fees; recipient responsible for travel, lodging and meals. Required training completed before December 31, 2025, so no remaining usable training window is verified.

awards.name: Southwest Airlines Dispatch Certification Scholarship
awards.conditions: Age at least 21, English proficiency, high-school diploma/GED, aspiring dispatcher, no previous aviation experience required. Outside direct graduating-high-school audience.

awards.name: Universal Weather & Aviation FAA-Certified Dispatcher Training Course Scholarship
awards.conditions: Hybrid dispatcher course, 4–8 months online then knowledge test and eight days in Houston. Applicant age/certification prerequisites and current usable award route are not established; no entry eligibility invented.

awards.name: Bunny M. Connors Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member pursuing private pilot certificate or instrument rating; finish flight training within one year of award.

awards.name: Delta Air Lines Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member working toward primary, instrument, commercial, CFI, CFII or MEI certification; intended for women advancing toward professional airline pilot career. Paid to school, complete within one year.

awards.name: Christine Reed Memorial Flight Scholarship
awards.conditions: Women ages 16–30 who soloed in the six months before application and pursue recreational, sport or private pilot certification; advanced certificates may be considered. Solo endorsement and additional 1–2 page Why I Love to Fly essay; New Jersey/Illinois/Arizona preference, all considered. Paid to flight school.

awards.name: The Dorothy Thompson/Tampa Bay Aviation Scholarship
awards.conditions: WAI member pursuing fixed-wing or rotorcraft private/commercial certificate or instrument rating at Tampa Bay Aviation. Training-account credit only, excludes examination and non-rental/instruction fees; cannot use solely for aircraft rental.

awards.name: WAI Atlanta “Wheels Down South” Chapter Scholarship
awards.conditions: Aviation education/training goals, merit, aspirations, dedication and community service; Atlanta chapter preference, all considered. Essay specifies training goal, use and timing; paid to training organization and used within one year.

awards.name: CAE 2025 Citation Bravo Type Rating Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 program requires 500 hours PIC plus 100 multi-engine and 100 instrument hours; advanced type rating outside entry-level audience.

awards.name: WAI2027 Scholarships
awards.conditions: Shared WAI parent program, not an additional individual fund. Current and historical catalog awards separately accounted for; parent inclusion policy remains separate.

awards.name: Harvard Emerging Leader 2027 Scholarships
awards.conditions: Official application requirements specify at least seven years of career experience; outside graduating-high-school audience.

awards.name: Delta Air Lines Engineering Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 full-time college junior/senior engineering program and GPA 3.0; outside direct high-school-to-postsecondary entry. Not listed in 2027 guide.

awards.name: The Carol M. SaNogueira Memorial Scholarship (Engineering)
awards.conditions: 2025 engineering variant $1,000, while 2027 combines career fields. Both guides contradict Connecticut residence/work/school requirement with all-applicants-considered wording. Do not merge distinct historical variants into a new unqualified national award.

awards.name: CAE 2025 Bombardier Learjet Maintenance Initial Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 program requires ICAO-license-equivalent maintenance knowledge/experience; no entry-level student pathway established. Not present in 2027 guide.

awards.name: Pratt & Whitney Engine Maintenance Training Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 requires near-completed AMT/A&P training or recent A&P graduate, excludes prior recipients and P&W employees; advanced course audience, not verified entry route. Not listed in 2027 guide.

awards.name: The Carol M. SaNogueira Memorial Scholarship (A&P)
awards.conditions: 2025 A&P variant $500, while 2027 combines career fields. Connecticut requirement/preference contradiction unresolved; retain variant and historical status.

awards.name: Southwest Airlines Maintenance Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 listing states two $2,000 awards with conference travel/toolbox but lacks award-specific applicant requirements; not listed in 2027 guide.

awards.name: Level Up Aviation Helo Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 guide extraction contains only name/$1,000 heading and no eligibility body; not listed in 2027. Coverage limitation retained.

awards.name: Kelsey A. Meyer Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: 2025 guide extraction contains only name/$2,500 heading and no eligibility body; not listed in 2027. Coverage limitation retained.

awards.name: The Carol M. SaNogueira Memorial Scholarship (Pilot)
awards.conditions: 2025 pilot variant $500, while 2027 combines career fields. Connecticut requirement/preference contradiction unresolved; retain variant and historical status.

awards.name: Wings Over 35 Scholarship
awards.conditions: Source row name is not present in the complete extracted 2025 or 2027 guides; 2025 extraction has an unattached $500 value. Identity and conditions unconfirmed, no amount inferred.

awards.name: Republic Airways Opportunity Elevated Scholarship (WAI2025)
awards.conditions: 2025 guide names Opportunity Elevated with RJet Cadet/commercial-pilot criteria; 2027 lists Republic Airways Flight with similar criteria but does not confirm rename. Retain as historical identity hold, avoiding a possible duplicate addition.

awards.name: Republic Airways Opportunity Elevated Scholarship
awards.conditions: Same WAI2025 award name, female commercial-pilot/RJet Cadet conditions and linked cadet route as historical Opportunity Elevated. All four source rows remain held with the unresolved potential rename to WAI Republic Airways Flight; no second addition.
